name: Shuthelah
overview: Shuthelah was a male descendant of the tribe of Ephraim, specifically identified as the son of Zabad according to 1 Chronicles 7:21. He is noted as a grandson within the Ephraim lineage and is distinguished from others with the same name by this familial connection. Scriptural notes indicate that he was killed by the men of Gath, marking a significant event in his life.
namesAndTitles: The name Shuthelah appears once in Scripture, in 1 Chronicles 7:21, with no specific meaning or divine origin provided. Thus, his name is simply recorded as a proper name without additional significance.
familyAndRelationships: Shuthelah is explicitly identified as the son of Zabad in 1 Chronicles 7:21. Beyond this, Scripture does not record further family relationships for him, and no other relatives are detailed in the provided information.
scriptureSignificance: Shuthelah’s significance lies in his place within the genealogical record of the tribe of Ephraim, highlighting the lineage of God’s chosen people. His death at the hands of the men of Gath reflects the ongoing conflicts faced by Israel and its tribes during the period recorded in Chronicles. Although not a prominent figure in narrative events, his mention preserves the memory of Ephraim’s descendants and the challenges they encountered.
